sections.Profile:
Lucky Strike and Bowl A Strike , both released by Williams in 1965, are classic electro-mechanical (EM) pinball machines designed by Norm Clark. These machines share the same bowling-themed playfield but were released in different formats: Lucky Strike is the replay version, while Bowl A Strike features an "Add-A-Ball" mechanic, making it more popular in regions with stricter replay regulations.
